design_philosophy.emotion: Authoritative, clear, structurally precise, and highly organized
core_principles: Function over Decoration - UI exists to surface data
Structural Borders - expose the skeleton of the layout
anti_patterns_enforced: No Inter or standard Sans for headings
No center-alignment for dense data or paragraphs
No heavy drop shadows (use borders and flat design)

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Mobile-first responsive. All dense content left-aligned. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

components.Navigation: Solid background (bg-white), 1px bottom border (border-slate-200). Sticky top-0, z-50. Logo left, main links left-aligned next to logo, user profile right.
components.MetricCard: Flat bg-white, 1px border. Overline label at top left. Huge Mono data metric at center. Green/Red trend indicator at bottom right. No shadow default.
components.ProjectCard: Used for Initiative and Asset Grids. Strict rectangle (rounded-sm). Top section: Status badge (right) and Title (left). Middle section: concise description. Bottom section: Domain tags (Shadcn Badge) and Avatar. Hover state: -translate-y-[2px] and border-slate-300.
components.FilterPanel: w-64 fixed width on desktop, collapsible on mobile. Dense Shadcn Checkboxes and Accordions. Left-aligned text.
components.DetailLayout: Two-column bento layout. 70% left (Overview, Business Context, Delivery). 30% right (Status, Metadata, Team, Insights).
components.Charts: Recharts ONLY. Sharp flat colors from charts_recharts array. Add custom tooltips with bg-white, border-slate-200, and text-slate-900. No drop shadows on bars.
components.Forms: Shadcn UI forms. Sharp inputs (rounded-sm), clear labeling. Left-aligned labels.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements explicitly set hover text color (e.g., hover:text-blue-700). Cards get slight lift and shadow-sm.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: High contrast ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-1 focus:outline-none.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for cards and buttons.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Never use transparent text or borders.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='submit-initiative-button', data-testid='metric-card-value').

hero_abstract.description: Abstract digital neural network for onboarding blocks or hero background
hero_abstract.usage: Use with heavy white overlay (bg-white/80) to maintain text contrast

network_abstract.usage: Use as a thumbnail for featured AI discovery assets

office_team_1.usage: Thumbnail for collaborative initiatives or community block

office_team_2.usage: Thumbnail for business context or PM onboarding section

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize with React, Tailwind, and Shadcn. Override Shadcn default radius to '0.125rem' (rounded-sm) in tailwind.config.js.
2. Add Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' to index.html and configure in Tailwind theme.
3. Install libraries: `yarn add recharts lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`.
4. Construct the Dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind CSS Grid (Control Room style) for structure. Wrap Shadcn components inside these grid items.
5. Ensure Recharts visualizations use the specific HEX codes from the 'charts_recharts' array.
6. Build the 'FilterPanel' for the Explore Initiatives page using Shadcn Checkboxes and Accordions.
7. Do NOT use placeholder image URLs like 'via.placeholder.com'. Map the provided Pexels URLs in the 'media' object to corresponding sections.
8. MANDATORY: Apply 'data-testid' to every actionable element.
9. Use Lucide-react for all icons to maintain the sharp, consistent enterprise feel.
